CustomField.description: Date the device was placed on the market. Starts the FIRST Eichfrist under § 37 Abs. 1 Satz 2 MessEG - and only the first. After any Nacheichung the period restarts from the calibration day instead (§ 34 Abs. 1 MessEV), which is why this field alone cannot compute the expiry.
